s.description: Evaluate and enforce backup patterns optimized for Cloudflare infrastructure: D1, R2, Durable Objects, Workers, KV. Covers automated scheduling, retention, integrity verification, disaster recovery, and cross-layer backup coordination.

scope.directories: infra/, config/, migrations/, scripts/, services/, lib/backup/, workers/

cloudflare_context.assumption: This project uses Cloudflare as primary infrastructure provider

product.name: D1
product.role: Primary SQLite database at the edge
product.notes: D1 has automatic daily backups (retained 30 days). Manual backups via API or Wrangler CLI. Time Travel for point-in-time recovery within 30 days (Workers Paid) or 7 days (Free).

product.name: R2
product.notes: S3-compatible API. Object lifecycle rules for retention. No egress fees. Natural backup vault for all CF storage layers.

product.name: Durable Objects
product.notes: Private transactional SQLite per DO. NO built-in backup API. Highest-risk layer -- requires custom export logic.

product.name: KV
product.notes: No built-in backup. Eventually consistent. Treat as cache, not truth.

product.name: Queues
product.role: Message queues for async backup orchestration

backup_system.requirement: MANDATORY: Backups automated, verified, restorable, schema-versioned. Use Cloudflare-native features (D1 Time Travel, R2 lifecycle, Cron Triggers) before building custom.

spec_document.format:
## Cloudflare Backup Inventory | Storage Layer | Product | Backup Method | Native? | Frequency | Retention | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | Primary DB | D1 | Time Travel + export to R2 | Partial | Continuous (TT) + scheduled (export) | 30d (TT) / custom (R2) | | Blob Storage | R2 | Object versioning + lifecycle | Yes | Per-write | Lifecycle rules | | Stateful Coordination | Durable Objects | Custom export to R2 | No | Cron Trigger | Custom | | Cache/Config | KV | Bulk export to R2 | No | Cron Trigger | Custom |
## Schema Awareness ## API Contract Awareness ## Integrity Verification ## Disaster Recovery (RTO/RPO) ## Connected Systems (sync-specs.md, state-specs.md)

architecture_principles.principle: D1 Time Travel and R2 lifecycle before custom. Don't rebuild what CF provides.
R2 zero-egress + S3 compat = natural backup destination for all CF storage.
DO has no native backup. Highest-risk layer. Explicit strategy mandatory.
Every D1 export includes migration version.
Unverified backup is not a backup.
The backup is just a file. The restore is the feature.

anti_patterns.violation: Durable Object storage with no export/backup strategy
Relying solely on D1 automatic backups without testing restore
D1 export without schema version in metadata
Secrets stored unencrypted in R2 backup artifacts
No R2 lifecycle rules on backup bucket
KV treated as source of truth with no backup
Backup Cron Trigger with no failure alerting
D1 Time Travel never tested for your schema
No backup observability via Analytics Engine
R2 backup bucket same account, no cross-account copy

durable-object-export
